hero.title: Antigravity Cleaner
hero.subtitle: Bypass Google Regional Sanctions & Enforce Zero-Telemetry
hero.tagline: Permanently neutralize strict Google Error 403 regional blocks, eliminate write EIO agent crashes with the Zero-Log ASAR shield, and inject direct proxy routing without TUN mode lag.

features.f1_desc: Direct machine-code binary patching (RAX+8 hasValidAuth = 1) completely resolves Error 403 Forbidden and regional eligibility blocks.
features.f2_desc: Enforces 8-flag enterprise isolation. Permanently severs background exfiltration of prompts, terminal history, git commits, and real IP beacons.
features.f3_desc: Silences verbose Google telemetry logging and handles broken console pipe errors (write EIO) to stop mid-stream agent crashes.
features.f4_desc: Routes IDE traffic directly into local v2rayN/Clash clients (10808 / 7890). Enable proxy once to connect, then turn VPN off! Zero TUN lag.
features.f5_desc: Purges corrupted rate-limit cookies and token buckets across 16 targets in 2 milliseconds while strictly preserving 100% of chats and logins.
features.f6_desc: Before altering a single byte, Cleaner creates untouched factory .agybak backups. Revert back to virgin factory state in 1 second.
features.f7_desc: 100% CGO-free, single standalone executable with zero external runtimes (no Python, no Node.js, no pip, no unsafe third-party DLLs).
features.f8_desc: Standalone GUI desktop window with 3-step automated workflow, plus interactive Lipgloss TUI terminal dashboard.

cta.title: Help Us Keep Antigravity Unchained
cta.text: Antigravity Cleaner is completely free, 100% offline, and open-source under Apache-2.0. Give us a star on GitHub to support ongoing machine-code patches and anti-sanction updates!

proxyNotice.title: Smart SOCKS5 Proxy Injection (One-Time Temporary Connect)
proxyNotice.desc: Cleaner automatically scans your local active proxy ports with zero manual setup. Simply turn on your local client (such as v2rayN, Nekoray, Clash, or Sing-box) once, launch the IDE, and after it establishes connection, you can safely TURN OFF YOUR VPN completely! The IDE keeps working stably without keeping a VPN active. If your connection drops, briefly turn on the proxy again.
